title: Naturality of augmented quotient presentations
statement: Let S be a coefficient derived-system calculus on W. Let Q,R be integral cochain complexes, C,D strict coefficient-system cochain complexes, and eC,eD and kappaC,kappaD be augmented reduction presentations. If h:Q→R and f:C→D are chain maps whose finite components satisfy evaluation(f) followed by kappaD = kappaC followed by scalarExtension(h), then S.reduction(Q(h)) followed by eD equals eC followed by Q(f), in the entire system derived category. No flatness, boundedness or detection of derived arrows by evaluation is assumed.

source.place: Scalar-extension adjunction and ordinary open extension (Tags 03CZ and 03DJ), with sites-cohomology.tex Tags 06YY and 0941; ordinary and augmentation steps of lem-sf-open-restriction-counit-on-good-complexes.

proof.text: Transport each augmentation component through the equality identifying restricted evaluation with finite scalar restriction. The prescribed section formula identifies it with the scalar-adjunction unit followed by inverse kappa.
Use the finite component square and scalar-unit naturality to prove the equality constant(h) followed by aD = aC followed by restriction(f), as strict chain-tower maps.

Localize this equality. Naturality of the two exact-functor factorization isomorphisms gives the equality after transposition along the constant-tower adjunction. Apply the augmented normalization equations and injectivity of the reduction adjunction hom equivalence.

lean.statement:
theorem augmentedReductionNaturality
    (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E W)
    (Q R : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E W) ℤ)
    (C D : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E W) ℤ)
    (eC : S.reduction.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q) ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj C)
    (eD : S.reduction.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj R) ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj D)
    (κC : ∀ n : ℕ,
      ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C ≅
        ((scalarReductionExtension l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)
    (κD : ∀ n : ℕ,
      ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj D ≅
        ((scalarReductionExtension l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj R)
    (hC : AugmentedPresentation l E W S Q C eC κC)
    (hD : AugmentedPresentation l E W S R D eD κD)
    (h : Q ⟶ R) (f : C ⟶ D)
    (hf : ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ),
      (coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).map (f.f i) ≫ (κD n).hom.f i =
        (κC n).hom.f i ≫ (scalarReductionExtension l E W n).map (h.f i)) :
    S.reduction.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map h) ≫ eD.hom =
      eC.hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map f
